请重新演示以修改已执行的需求。: Restart the demo to edit an executed request.

超时会停止当前 Agent 并保留已有代码，由你确认后重试；不会自动提交或推送。: Timeout stops the Agent and preserves code. Retry requires your confirmation; no automatic commit or push.
输入一个不存在的规则名称。: Enter a rule name that does not exist.
运行筛选、重置及空状态用例，启动页面供人工验收。: Verify filters, reset and empty states, then launch for acceptance.
这里仅显示当前项目的任务，新建任务会默认选择此项目。: Only tasks for this project appear here. New tasks default to this project.

通知失败不会中断任务。企业微信只发送任务摘要，不发送需求正文、代码、截图或错误日: Notification failures do not stop tasks. WeCom sends summaries only, without requirements, code, screenshots, or error logs. Milestones are not automatically resent.
配置你自己的项目与连接，让工作台适应你的工作方式。: Connect your own repositories and tools to fit the way you work.
配置有未保存的修改，记得保存后再离开。: You have unsaved changes. Save before leaving.
重试只执行失效或失败步骤；有效的已通过检查点会保留。: Retry runs only failed or invalid steps; valid passed checkpoints are retained.
项目 ID 保存后作为任务与配置的稳定标识，请使用简短英文名称。: The project ID is the stable task and settings identifier. Use a short ASCII name.
项目 ID 只能包含字母、数字、下划线和短横线，最长 60 个字符。: Project ID may contain only letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens, up to 60 characters.
项目就绪后自动打开到这个页面。: Open this page automatically once the project is ready.
首次使用建议先完成本地执行体检，再开始任务。: Run setup checks before your first task.
首次使用需要联网下载版本匹配的组件，仅写入当前用户缓存，不修改业务项目。Chro: First use requires a matching component download into the current user's cache, without changing the business project. Chrome success cannot substitute for Firefox success.
默认不启用。修改结束后直接由你在现有浏览器查看，无需额外登录或打开测试浏览器。: Off by default. Review the edit in your existing browser; no extra login or test browser required.
默认只允许测试页面同源请求。需要跨域测试接口时，每行填写一个非生产域名，包含协议: Only same-origin test requests are allowed by default. For cross-origin test APIs, enter one non-production origin per line, with protocol and port but no path.
